what: Title floats offset to the upper left (−.3rem·−3.5rem), tilted −3°, blurred .2rem and transparent, then once past 85% of the screen it settles upright into place over .75s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94). With split: chars, each letter follows .1s later over 1.2s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), one by one — a numbered heading and small title that land like a paper slip set down

options.split: ”chars” sets each character separately (words are grouped as inline-block chunks to keep line break positions)
options.on: “load” runs right on attach (hero heading of the original brand page)
options.line: At what fraction from the top of the screen it settles in, default .85
options.--fx-x · --fx-y · --fx-tilt · --fx-blur: Floating position, tilt and blur, default −.3rem · −3.5rem · −3deg · .2rem
